records.japanese:
イギリスはイングランド
スコットランド、ウェールズの連合王国
なんですよ。これからもどんどん発展
していくでしょう。女王様万歳！
records.current_English: England unites England, Scotland, and Wales. It will surely keep growing. Long live the Queen!
records.english: Britain is a union of England, Scotland and Wales. It'll keep prospering. Long live the Queen!{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Britain is a united kingdom of England, Scotland and Wales; the speaker predicts further development and cheers the Queen.
records.localization_note: Restore Britain as the union, distinct from constituent England; preserve the game's setting and Queen cheer without substituting modern history.
records.speaker: Original Square shopkeeper selected by town actor getter at5F9C4
records.context: Original5FA60 chooses688+native town region when the company-specific town flag getterB4A88 is nonzero; otherwise709+region selects the separate rumor family. Direct portrait parent54014; independent topic selections, not a sequential history lecture.

records.japanese:
オランダは長い独立戦争の末
スペインから独立して間もない
国なんです
records.current_English: After a long war, the Netherlands recently broke from Spain.
records.english: The Netherlands only recently won independence from Spain, after a long war.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: The Netherlands has only recently won independence from Spain following a long war of independence.
records.localization_note: Won independence is more idiomatic and explicit than broke from Spain; retain only recently and the long war.
records.speaker: Original Square shopkeeper selected by town actor getter at5F9C4
records.context: Original5FA60 chooses688+native town region when the company-specific town flag getterB4A88 is nonzero; otherwise709+region selects the separate rumor family. Direct portrait parent54014; independent topic selections, not a sequential history lecture.

records.japanese:
ヨーロッパの交易を牛耳っていた
ハンザ同盟もインド航路や新大陸が
発見されてからというもの
めっきり影が薄くなっちゃってねえ…
records.current_English: The Hanseatic League once ruled European trade, but faded after routes to India and the New World opened.
records.english: The Hanseatic League once dominated European trade. It's faded since the sea route to India and the New World were discovered.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: The Hanseatic League formerly controlled European trade but has faded markedly since discovery of the India sea route and the New World.
records.localization_note: Keep the discovery of both the sea route and New World and the loss of commercial dominance in natural spoken prose.
records.speaker: Original Square shopkeeper selected by town actor getter at5F9C4
records.context: Original5FA60 chooses688+native town region when the company-specific town flag getterB4A88 is nonzero; otherwise709+region selects the separate rumor family. Direct portrait parent54014; independent topic selections, not a sequential history lecture.

records.japanese:
スウェーデンというのはつい最近
デンマークやノルウェーとの
カルマル同盟から独立したんですよ
records.current_English: Sweden recently left the Kalmar Union with Denmark and Norway.
records.english: Sweden only recently gained independence from the Kalmar Union with Denmark and Norway.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Sweden has recently become independent from the Kalmar Union with Denmark and Norway.
records.localization_note: Restore gained independence rather than merely left the union.
records.speaker: Original Square shopkeeper selected by town actor getter at5F9C4

records.japanese:
ポルトガルですか？
ついこの間までは
ほぼ全世界の海を手中に
してたんですけどねえ
records.current_English: Portugal? Until quite recently, it controlled nearly all the world's seas.
records.english: Portugal? Until recently, it ruled almost all the world's seas.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Until quite recently Portugal held almost all the seas of the world; the speaker sounds wistful.
records.localization_note: Preserve the wistful recent loss of dominance over nearly all seas in fluent prose, without leaving seas isolated on a short final row.

records.japanese:
スペインは繁栄しているでしょう？
他国の人は、『太陽の沈まない帝国』
なんて呼んでいるらしいですねえ
records.current_English: Spain prospers, doesn't it? Other nations call it the empire where the sun never sets.
records.english: Spain prospers, doesn't it? Other nations call it the empire where the sun never sets.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Spain is prospering; people in other countries reportedly call it the empire on which the sun never sets.
records.localization_note: Retain the already natural wording: it preserves all source facts, register and narrative perspective.

records.japanese:
ジェノヴァやヴェネツィアの
イタリア都市国家はインド航路が
開通してからというもの、すっかり
東方貿易の権利を奪われちゃって…
records.current_English: Since the India route opened, Italian city-states like Genoa and Venice have lost their eastern trade.
records.english: Since the sea route to India opened, Italian city-states like Genoa and Venice have lost their hold on eastern trade.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Opening the India route stripped Italian city-states such as Genoa and Venice of their eastern-trade rights.
records.localization_note: Hold on eastern trade naturally conveys the trade-rights loss; retain the India route and both city-state examples.

records.japanese:

占領されて以来、教会はみんな
モスクになっちゃったんですよ
records.current_English: Since the Ottomans occupied Greece, many churches have been turned into mosques.
records.english: Since the Ottoman Turks occupied Greece, all the churches have been turned into mosques.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: The speaker claims that all the churches became mosques after Ottoman Turkish occupation of Greece.
records.localization_note: The source says all, not many; preserve this NPC's historical claim rather than silently qualifying it.

首都だったんですよ
records.current_English: Istanbul was once Constantinople, capital of the Eastern Roman and Byzantine empires.
records.english: Istanbul was once Constantinople, capital of the Eastern Roman and Byzantine empires.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Istanbul used to be called Constantinople and was capital of the Eastern Roman and Byzantine empires, as the game phrases it.
records.localization_note: Retain the already natural wording: it preserves all source facts, register and narrative perspective.

オスマン帝国の属領なんですよ

大帝には頭が上がらないみたいで…
records.current_English: North African cities are Ottoman subjects. Even the Mediterranean pirates bow to the Sultan.
records.english: North Africa's cities are all under Ottoman rule. Even the pirates of the Mediterranean seem to answer to the Sultan.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: North African cities are all Ottoman dependencies; even Mediterranean pirates apparently cannot defy the great ruler.
records.localization_note: Restore the all-cities scope and tentative seem for the pirates; Sultan follows the established localization of this ruler.

…異教徒とはこれ以上話をしたく
ありません

いけませんよ
すべては前世の業によるものなのです
records.current_English: Do not blame others. Misfortune comes from deeds in a former life.
records.english: Don't blame others for your misfortune. It all comes from karma in your past life.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Do not blame others for your misfortune: it is all due to karma from a previous life.
records.localization_note: Restore your misfortune and the explicit karma concept; this is NPC doctrine, not advice from the translator.

このあたりの王国は、かつては
明（ミン）帝国に服従していたんですよ
今の明には、全盛期の頃の
威光など、影も形もありませんけれど…
records.current_English: Kingdoms here once submitted to Ming China, but today's Ming has lost its former glory.
records.english: The kingdoms here once bowed to the Ming Empire. There's not a trace of its former glory left now, though.{PAD}
records.source_meaning: Surrounding kingdoms once submitted to the Ming Empire; its present prestige is only a shadow of its peak, indeed the speaker says none remains.
records.localization_note: Keep the speaker's emphatic judgment about former Ming prestige and the contrast with subject kingdoms.

records.localization_note: Restore worsening disorder and the speaker's dismay, omitted by the terse current draft.
